blocks.text: Computational biology ek interdisciplinary (kai mazameen ko jodne wala) shoba hai jo biology ke masail hal karne ke liye computer ki techniques aur tools istemal karta hai. Is mein biology, computer science, mathematics aur statistics ka ilm mila kar biological data ko parha aur samjha jata hai. Is ki ahmiyat yeh hai ke yeh bohat bade datasets sambhal sakti hai, chhupe hue patterns dhoond sakti hai, aur aise predictive models (aage ka andaza lagane wale models) bana sakti hai jin se biology mein nayi samajh aur naye faide milte hain. Computational biology ke bade hisse (areas) yeh hain:

items: Genomics: genomes ka mutala (study). Genome kisi jandar (organism) ke ek cell ke andar maujood poora DNA hai. Genomics mein genomes ki sequencing (tarteeb parhna), assembling (tukde jodna) aur un ki structure aur kaam ka tajziya (analysis) hota hai. Is se genetic variations (genes ke farq), gene ka kaam aur evolutionary relationships (irtiqai rishte) samajh aate hain.

Proteomics: proteins ka bade paimane par mutala, un ki structure aur kaam samet. Proteins zaroori molecules hain jo jandar mein bohat se kaam karte hain. Proteomics ka maqsad hai ke kisi jandar ke banaye hue tamam proteins (proteome) ka naqsha banaya jaye aur samjha jaye ke cell ke kaamon mein yeh aapas mein kaise milte aur kya kirdar ada karte hain.

Bioinformatics: biological data ko sambhalne aur parhne ke liye computer technology ka istemal. Bioinformatics ke tools DNA, RNA aur protein sequences ko store karne, wapas nikalne (retrieve) aur analyze karne mein kaam aate hain.
